g.text: Product Term And Condition Type : ProductTermAndConditionType
Product Context Specific Term and Condition
Product Pricing and Fee Term and Condition
Product Documentation Required Term and Condition
Priority or Override Rules : Rule Set
Asset Type: Preoduct and Service Discount
Example Scenario: Credit Card Annual Fee Discount
A bank’s product manager for Credit Cards wants to boost adoption of the Platinum Card. To encourage
uptake, they decide to temporarily reduce the annual card fee.
- Discounted Pricing (Override): Reduced to $60 annual fee (50% discount)
- Eligibility Criteria: New customers applying online before June 30
- Authority / Approval: Product Manager (within delegated authority to adjust product fees)
- Purpose: Increase Platinum Card adoption among digital-first customers
- Impact: Short-term reduction in fee revenue (absorbed in the product P&L), with expected offset from
